headline: Fortinet warns of actively exploited FortiMail zero-day flaw
summary: Fortinet warned that a critical FortiMail vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-104286, is being actively exploited in zero-day attacks requiring no login, with some administrators still waiting for patches.

claims.statement: Fortinet warned of a critical FortiMail vulnerability, CVE-2026-104286, being actively exploited in zero-day attacks.
